blocks.text: Lakeshore React stock admin, technical design

This is the working cut for LSH-TDD-2023-058 on October 26, 2023. Mara Singh asked for a written bound after the current path (Woo wp-admin for counts, four logins) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Luis Ortega, Cole Brennan, and Mara Singh. Primary host admin.lakeshore.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on browser writes to Woo REST, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

React admin reads inv-api. Cycle-count adjustments POST to inv-api, which writes MySQL, which projects. No Woo REST from the browser. I am not restating a hallway yes. browser writes to Woo REST is out because A store manager with a Woo token is a second ledger. Mara will not sign it. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at stores=4, logins=4, p95=0.9, weeks=8, screens=5, write=0, cycle=12.4, sku=18.4k. Sibling tickets LSH-5020 and LSH-TDD-2022-022. I will not reopen browser writes to Woo REST in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Cole Brennan is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Mara Singh owns a leftover that is easy to skip: stg-admin.lakeshore.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (34): refuse on browser writes to Woo REST, lock is React read, API write, MySQL ledger, Woo projection only. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on LSH-5020.
If the admin can write Woo, we are back to two ledgers with a nicer font.

What a skeptical user would try first on admin.lakeshore.internal: the path Mara Singh actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on inv-api.lakeshore.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.

What I will not claim in LSH-TDD-2023-058

I will not claim browser writes to Woo REST is impossible for a competitor. I will claim we will not buy it. I will not claim zero incidents after this cut. I will claim the next one dies at the gate named in the lock. Host admin.lakeshore.internal.

First useful is React read, API write, MySQL ledger, Woo projection only, not a prettier theme or a bigger box. Mara Singh sees that slice on admin.lakeshore.internal. If the slice needs a second product, that is a new ticket and Luis Ortega is in the thread. I will not hide it inside LSH-TDD-2023-058.
